data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 静夜床榻的白棉吊带私语
data.description: 深夜弦神岛的公寓卧室内，床头台灯的光芒昏暗而温暖。雪菜身穿纯白细吊带纯棉睡裙坐在床头，乌黑的长发松散垂在光滑的背脊与胸前。她怀中抱着松软白枕，赤足在被单边缘微露。褐眸水光盈盈，面对近在咫尺的目光，少女脸颊泛着滚烫的红晕，微启温软唇瓣轻声诉说着心底最真实的爱恋。
data.action: 坐在床畔怀抱棉枕微红面颊，双眸温柔含情望向视角
data.lighting: 暖黄床头台灯柔光与微暗卧室内景
data.camera: 半身中景平视，焦距虚化背景床幔
data.promptProse: In a tranquil apartment bedroom late at night, Yukina sits comfortably on her bed bathed in warm amber lamplight. Dressed in a delicate white cotton camisole with thin shoulder straps, she hugs a soft white pillow against her chest. Her silky dark hair falls naturally across bare shoulders, while her blushing cheeks and tender amber-brown eyes gaze softly at the viewer with an earnest, loving confession.
data.animaCaption: Sitting on the bed hugging a pillow under warm lamplight, her cheeks flushed with sweet loving confession.
